r135/cold-remainder-envelope.question: Can direct signed seed subtraction in the nine-center Laurent envelope certify the exact remaining physical step below 0.472?
r135/cold-remainder-envelope.scope: Use actual V601 and V602 over closed Q, translated P5000 with both boundary pairs and physical t0=n. Subtract the pure-seed coefficients before modulus, price every remaining weight, and give an explicit analytic tail.
r135/cold-remainder-envelope.remaining: Bound the actual nonlinear remainder in physical price at the same frozen heights and square. A separate remainder estimate would suffice at the two center rows; the invariant and half-step sheet margins would still need proof.

r135/cold-remainder-geometric.question: Can direct geometric relative pricing prove or obstruct the very same remainder norm below 0.472?
r135/cold-remainder-geometric.scope: Use exactly the same actual h=601,602, Q, t0=n and P5000 as the envelope route. Work by signed transport of mixed word weights, relative seed powers or a genuine packet witness. Counting norm and position flatness do not price this norm.
r135/cold-remainder-geometric.remaining: Bound the actual nonlinear remainder in physical price at the same frozen heights and square. A separate remainder estimate would suffice at the two center rows; the invariant and half-step sheet margins would still need proof.

r135/ordinary-window-signed-tail.question: Can complementary ordinary support bound the signed high seed tail or give true clipped-window parity?
r135/ordinary-window-signed-tail.scope: Use the actual prime ordinary optimizer, fixed cap at the mark and complementary positive factors with disjoint bulk support. Either upper must be prime uniform in the stated fixed-window order. Avoid positing full optimizer L2 without proof.
r135/ordinary-window-signed-tail.remaining: Provide a bounded-window parity approximation of the actual ordinary activation and control its signed high tail, or find a direct support-sensitive cancellation argument through all eligible primes.

known_shared.statement: For all sufficiently large primes p=1 mod 4, uniformly on the original closed cold square and for h=601 and h=602, the actual physical translated P5000 operator norm of K(D_h-D^J) is strictly below 0.472 with a field-uniform gap. D^J is the full derivative at the Jacobi seed using the actual marked floor n.

comparison: The envelope and geometric calls both test the same one-step actual remainder K(D_h-D^J) below 0.472 in P5000 for h=601,602 on the same closed square and with the same mark. They deliberately share one candidate while testing two distinct mathematical methods. The ordinary weighted-window and signed-tail call is at zero floor and uses the exact ordinary complementary pair, so it needs no cold remainder estimate. All old research runs and independent reviews are terminal; no active prior route is included.
